suggestions.reason: The revised output omits At a Glance and still passes. Make presence mandatory if the eval is intended to assess the quality of that section.

All six assertions pass both with_skill and old_skill, so this eval is wholly non-discriminating for the iteration. Add checks for whether the primary proof prioritizes product influence over participant count, whether scope expansion is described as a request rather than an implemented feature, and whether observed versus author-reported evidence is handled consistently.

eval_feedback.overall: The assertions are useful baseline safeguards, but every one passes both variants and therefore this eval cannot measure improvement in iteration 2.
